terra.problem: The joke compares how the kings’ names sound, which Papa Dorin’s rules prohibit. The statement that Hezekiah is a different king also needs a reference outside this passage.
The statement that Josiah is another king of Judah needs a reference outside this passage. The sprinkle joke also has no established difference between the two bags to explain the surprise.
The greeting-card joke repeats the get-well-card joke from the first explanation.
Reading the words aloud does not establish whether the scroll is a secret or who, if anyone, hears it.
The passage does not say how long the scroll is.
The geographical statement about the Euphrates goes beyond this passage and needs its own reference.
The explanation is flat and generic: it repeats that the line is at the end and comments on sticking to the text without adding a meaningful observation.
